description: Click an element. Pass ref (e.g. "e12") from browser_snapshot — exact, no guessing. Selector is the fallback (CSS, text="...", :has-text(...), role=...; never :contains()). By default the response includes an AI snapshot diff of what changed, so you usually do NOT need a follow-up browser_snapshot.

nthMatch.description: If the selector matches multiple elements, target the Nth (0-indexed).

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector — exact match, no guessing.

returnSnapshot.description: Legacy inline snapshot (tree modes). Prefer the "snapshot" param, which returns ref-based AI snapshots.

selector.description: Playwright selector for the element to click (CSS, text="...", :has-text("..."), role=..., [data-testid="..."]). Fallback when you have no ref. NEVER use :contains().

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

snapshot.description: Inline AI snapshot after the click. Default "diff" = only the changed region vs your last snapshot. "none" = terse response.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

textHint.description: What you meant to click, in words (e.g. "Account settings"). If the selector matches nothing the server first tries an exact role+name match; failing that, the visible candidates are ranked against this phrase and the best one is named in the error. Advisory unless safe auto-heal is switched on.

name: browser_click
